for: Not placed in the deck yet. The joints finding in the studio's own drawing: a joint a clinging plant reaches, as every lap is cut and as it is now cut.
shows: The lap between R1.fine.cw.03 and R1.fill.ccw.06 three times, looked at squarely from outside, along the way the roof faces there: bare, as every lap is cut (snapshot six-bay-radial-v1); bare, cut splayed (six-bay-radial-v2); and the splayed lap after ten tended years, with the ivy on it. statement: A growth scenario on stated assumptions, not a forecast. Concept geometry; trial planting.
